privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Dr. Ahmed Gamal El-Borhamy's clinic ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through this website, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you submit our consultation request form, we collect the details you provide — such as your name, phone number, age, procedure of interest, preferred date/time, and any message you include. We do not collect payment information through this website.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information you submit solely to respond to your inquiry, schedule a consultation, and communicate with you about your care. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: Consultation requests are delivered to our team using a trusted transactional email provider. This provider processes your submission only to deliver it to us and does not use it for any other purpose.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website uses only the minimal technical storage required for it to function correctly (such as remembering your selected language). We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Patient Confidentiality
sections.body: Any medical information you share with us in connection with a consultation is treated as confidential and handled in line with standard medical confidentiality practices.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may ask us at any time to access, correct, or delete the information you have submitted to us. Contact us using the details on our Contact page to make a request.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out via the phone number or email address listed on our Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using this website, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Use of This Website
sections.body: This website is provided for informational purposes to help you learn about our practice and request a consultation. You agree to use it only for lawful purposes.

sections.heading: Not Medical Advice
sections.body: The content on this website — including procedure descriptions, before/after examples, and articles — is for general information only and does not constitute medical advice. Individual results vary, and every recommendation should be confirmed during an in-person consultation with Dr. Ahmed Gamal El-Borhamy.

sections.heading: Consultation Requests
sections.body: Submitting the consultation form does not guarantee an appointment at the specific date or time requested. Our team will contact you to confirm availability.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: All text, images, and design on this website are the property of the clinic or its licensors and may not be reproduced without permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: We make reasonable efforts to keep this website accurate and available, but we do not guarantee it will be error-free or uninterrupted, and we are not liable for decisions made solely on the basis of website content without a consultation.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be directed to us via the details on our Contact page.

hero.paragraph: Experience world-class plastic surgery tailored to your unique harmony. Dr. Ahmed Gamal combines surgical precision with an artistic eye to deliver elegant, transformative results.

about.heading: Dr. Ahmed Gamal
about.paragraph1: With over 20 years of dedicated practice, Dr. Gamal is renowned for his meticulous technique and commitment to patient safety and satisfaction.
about.paragraph2: His philosophy centers on enhancing individual beauty through subtle, natural-looking refinements, ensuring every patient feels confident and empowered in their own skin.

whyChooseUs.heading: Why Choose Dr. Ahmed Gamal El-Borhamy
whyChooseUs.paragraph: With a commitment to excellence and a passion for aesthetic harmony, Dr. Gamal provides a transformative experience that prioritizes your safety, comfort, and natural beauty.

finalCta.paragraph: Schedule a private consultation with Dr. Ahmed Gamal to discuss your aesthetic goals and discover a personalized treatment plan tailored just for you.

hero.title: Meet Dr. Ahmed Gamal El-Borhamy
hero.paragraph: Dedicated to the pursuit of aesthetic harmony through surgical excellence and artistic vision.

message.paragraph1: "My philosophy has always been centered on the individual. Every face and body tells a unique story, and my goal is never to change that narrative, but to enhance its most beautiful chapters. We strive for results that whisper, rather than shout.
message.paragraph2: Through years of refined technique and an unwavering commitment to safety, I approach each procedure as a collaboration between surgical precision and your personal aesthetic goals. Trust is the foundation of our practice."

video.paragraph: Dr. Gamal brings over two decades of specialized expertise in aesthetic plastic surgery. His comprehensive approach integrates the latest advancements in medical technology with a deeply ingrained understanding of anatomical harmony. Since founding his premier practice in 2012, he has helped thousands of patients achieve subtle, elegant, and long-lasting results.
